title: Rear Brake Pads Replacement
summary: Repair guide, labor context, and estimate workflow for rear brake pads replacement.
repair_overview: Confirm brake pad wear and related rotor condition
Remove wheel and brake assembly hardware
Replace worn rear brake pads and service hardware
Road test or confirm proper pedal feel when applicable
tools_required: Brake piston compressor or rewind tool

torque_specs.label: Wheel lug nuts
torque_specs.value: Vehicle specific - load vehicle for exact spec

torque_specs.label: Caliper bracket bolts
torque_specs.value: Vehicle specific - load vehicle for exact spec

torque_specs.label: Slide pin bolts
torque_specs.value: Vehicle specific - load vehicle for exact spec

repair_steps: Raise and support the vehicle safely.
Retract or rewind piston as required.
Reinstall wheel and torque lug nuts.
Pump brake pedal before moving vehicle.
pro_tips: Check parking brake design before retracting rear pistons.
Inspect rotor wear pattern before reinstalling components.
Replace pad hardware clips when included.
Torque fasteners properly and avoid overtightening.
warnings: Do not let the caliper hang by the brake hose.
Some rear calipers require a piston rewind tool.
Do not drive until brake pedal feel is restored.

diagnostic_context.intro: Rear brake wear may begin with noise, drag, or uneven braking before replacement is needed.
